candidates.statement: POLICY An applicant may transfer ownership of its application under 21 CFR 314.72. At the time of transfer, the new and former owners are required to submit information to the Food and Drug Administration (FDA).
candidates.context: Effective Date: 8/26/2020 Page 1 of 6 An applicant may also submit changes in application information relating to corporate mergers and acquisitions.
